nodes.label: [DOC] Bot Rider Master Product Requirements
nodes.description: Status: **authoritative product roadmap** Baseline date: **2026-09-04**

nodes.label: [SECTION] 1. Document authority · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md
nodes.title: 1. Document authority
nodes.description: This document defines the product direction and supersedes contradictory scope decisions in the revision-7 MVP documents. Existing OpenSpec requirements remain the acceptance contract for shipped behavior until a superseding recovery requirement is implemented.

nodes.label: [SECTION] 2. Audited baseline · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md
nodes.title: 2. Audited baseline
nodes.description: The repository is beyond the original MVP baseline:

nodes.label: [SECTION] PRD-C1 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_3_product_constraints
nodes.title: PRD-C1 — Copilot only
nodes.description: All model requests MUST use `vscode.lm` with Copilot models. Bot Rider MUST NOT require separate model API keys.

nodes.label: [SECTION] PRD-C2 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_3_product_constraints
nodes.title: PRD-C2 — Deterministic control plane
nodes.description: Scheduling, dependency validation, cancellation, concurrency, approvals, and workspace-write safety MUST remain deterministic host responsibilities.

nodes.label: [SECTION] PRD-C3 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_3_product_constraints
nodes.title: PRD-C3 — Local-first context
nodes.description: Repository indexing and documentation retrieval MUST run locally by default. Missing optional semantic components MUST degrade to deterministic symbol and text retrieval.

nodes.label: [SECTION] PRD-C4 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_3_product_constraints
nodes.title: PRD-C4 — Explicit side-effect approval
nodes.description: Workspace writes and mutating MCP calls MUST remain separately reviewable. Approval MUST be understandable as one review workflow without silently combining the two side-effect gates.

nodes.label: [SECTION] 4. Recovery requirements · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md
nodes.title: 4. Recovery requirements
nodes.description: Detailed acceptance criteria are in `openspec/specs/pu-1-product-usability/spec.md`.

nodes.label: [SECTION] PU-1 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_4_recovery_requirements
nodes.title: PU-1 — Protected core bots
nodes.description: Every installation MUST contain one active Spec bot and one active Dispatcher bot. Users MAY change model and safe persona wording. Users MUST NOT delete, deactivate, undesignate, or remove the core responsibility clauses from these bots.

nodes.label: [SECTION] PU-2 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_4_recovery_requirements
nodes.title: PU-2 — Swarm transcript parity
nodes.description: The sidebar and expanded Swarm MUST show the same ordered user turns, bot turns, notices, errors, Split state, and pending-review state whenever either webview is created or reopened.

nodes.label: [SECTION] PU-3 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_4_recovery_requirements
nodes.title: PU-3 — Bounded Copilot concurrency
nodes.description: Bot Rider MUST bound concurrent Copilot requests. Excess requests MUST queue. Stop MUST cancel queued and in-flight work belonging to the run. Rate-limit failures MUST use bounded retry with visible status.

nodes.label: [SECTION] PU-4 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_4_recovery_requirements
nodes.title: PU-4 — Dependency-aware execution
nodes.description: The Dispatcher MUST emit a typed task dependency graph. Host code MUST reject cycles, unknown bots, missing artifacts, unsafe ordering, and overlapping path claims within a parallel wave.

nodes.label: [SECTION] PU-5 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_4_recovery_requirements
nodes.title: PU-5 — Synthesis-based Debate
nodes.description: Debate MUST separate independent proposals, synthesis, targeted objections, and decision. Ordinary decisions MUST support a configurable quorum policy. Unanimity MUST be reserved for configured high-risk decisions.

nodes.label: [SECTION] PU-6 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_4_recovery_requirements
nodes.title: PU-6 — Consolidated review
nodes.description: Swarm MUST expose one idempotent review entry point for pending files and MCP actions. File and MCP approval MUST remain separate safety gates.

nodes.label: [SECTION] PU-7 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_4_recovery_requirements
nodes.title: PU-7 — Reload recovery
nodes.description: Bot Rider MUST persist enough workspace-scoped state to recover the transcript, run phase, dependency graph, Run Board, and pending file review after reload.

nodes.label: [SECTION] PU-8 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_4_recovery_requirements
nodes.title: PU-8 — Public installation
nodes.description: Bot Rider MUST produce an installable VSIX artifact. Installation and first successful task MUST not require cloning the repository or launching an Extension Development Host.

nodes.label: [SECTION] CTX-1 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_5_capability_roadmap
nodes.title: CTX-1 — Whole-repository code graph
nodes.description: Build a local index of files, symbols, imports, and available call relationships. Prompt assembly MUST inject task-relevant neighborhoods rather than whole files.

nodes.label: [SECTION] CTX-2 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_5_capability_roadmap
nodes.title: CTX-2 — Local documentation retrieval
nodes.description: Index local Markdown and return the most relevant passages for a task without an external vector database.

nodes.label: [SECTION] CTX-3 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_5_capability_roadmap
nodes.title: CTX-3 — Requirements graph links
nodes.description: Link OpenSpec requirements, task nodes, code nodes, and proposed files. Preserve verbatim acceptance criteria when they are required context.

nodes.label: [SECTION] EDIT-1 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_5_capability_roadmap
nodes.title: EDIT-1 — Selective hunk patching
nodes.description: Generated text changes MUST support validated unified hunks, stale-base detection, per-file inclusion, preview, and explicit apply.

nodes.label: [SECTION] PORT-1 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_5_capability_roadmap
nodes.title: PORT-1 — Bot profile portability
nodes.description: Users MUST be able to import and export one or more bot profiles as JSON or YAML.

nodes.label: [SECTION] AUD-1 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_5_capability_roadmap
nodes.title: AUD-1 — Technical-debt audit
nodes.description: After the core workflow is stable, the product SHOULD index TODO, FIXME, unhandled failure paths, and unimplemented contracts in a dedicated audit view.

nodes.label: [SECTION] VIZ-1 · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md · doc_docs_master_product_requirement_document_md_5_capability_roadmap
nodes.title: VIZ-1 — Context visualization
nodes.description: After repository context is validated, the product SHOULD provide a useful 2D dependency and run-activity visualization. 3D visualization MUST remain optional and MUST be justified by usability evidence.

nodes.label: [SECTION] 7. Delivery order · docs_master_product_requirement_document_md
nodes.title: 7. Delivery order
nodes.description: 1. P0: requirements baseline, traceability crosswalk, and development knowledge graph. 2. P0: transcript, review, MCP confirmation, protected core bots, and onboarding. 3. P1: deterministic dependency scheduler and bounded Copilot queue. 4. P1: synthesis-based Debate and calmer parallel UI. 5. P2: hunk patching and reload recovery. 6. P3: whole-repository context and public distribution. 7. P4: technical-debt dashboard and richer visualization.
